name: Workspace Ops Radar
description: Real-time multi-agent ops dashboard for Orca: cleanup countdowns & Trash undo, storage top offenders & triage, Bots & live agent radar, memory diagnostics, backups, doctor & startup token audit, with Bot alert handoffs.

commands.title: Ops Radar: Run Daily GC to Trash
Ops Radar: Ask Bot to Review Current Alerts

statusBarItems.tooltip: Workspace Ops Radar — cleanup countdown, storage, bots and health

settings.title: Target Orca Bot name
settings.description: Bot that receives alert handoffs and synthesizes feedback for you (e.g. Ram).

settings.title: Automatic Bot alert handoff
settings.description: When to automatically send issues to your Bot for analysis and feedback (deduplicated with a 6-hour cooldown per issue).

settings.title: Desktop alert notifications
settings.description: Show an Orca desktop notification when a new critical or warning alert appears.

settings.title: Low disk warning threshold (%)
settings.description: Warn when free space on the workspace disk drops below this percentage (critical below half of this).

settings.title: Agent waiting reminder (minutes)
settings.description: Highlight an agent stuck waiting for your reply or permission after this many minutes.

settings.title: GC spike alert threshold (GiB)
settings.description: Warn if a single cleanup pass reclaims at least this many GiB.

settings.title: Fallback GC interval (hours)
settings.description: Used if AGENT_HYGIENE_GC_INTERVAL_SEC is not set in ~/.orca/backup-config.env.

settings.title: Auto-refresh interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often the worker refreshes fast telemetry (timers, jobs, bots, live workspaces).
